about: The Chromium and headless shell revisions the stage copies into the app (bundle.mjs checkBrowser, review e A-M3): each Playwright revision folder's tree digest — every path, link target, file size, executable bit and file sha256, Playwright's marker files left out — recorded from an install of playwright-core 1.56.1 on Apple silicon. Playwright's installer checks no hash: the build refuses any other tree. Upgrading playwright-core: install its revisions, check them, record each with `node apps/desktop/scripts/bundle.mjs browser-digest <ms-playwright>/<folder>`.
